info.name: Mastercard Developer Hub for FDX APIs FDX Authorization Server Application Check Controller Non PAR Authorize API
Mastercard Developer Hub for FDX APIs User Authorization Endpoint

params.name: client_id
params.description: The client identifier issued to the client during the registration process.

params.name: response_type
params.description: The type of response requested. `code` for an authorization code or `token` for an implicit token.

params.name: code_challenge
params.description: A code challenge used in the PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) flow, if applicable.

params.name: code_challenge_method
params.description: The method used to generate the code challenge (e.g., `plain` or `S256`).

params.name: request_uri
params.description: The URI generated from PAR endpoint.

params.name: scope
params.description: The scope of access requested by the client. For example, `read` or `write`.

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: The URI to which the authorization server will redirect the user after granting or denying access.

params.name: request
params.description: JWT request object for non par flow

params.name: state
params.description: A client generated value used to maintain state between the request and callback to prevent CSRF attacks.

items.docs: This endpoint allows users to authorize a client application to access their resources. It returns an authorization code or token based on the grant type and flow. (Don't hit copy the url from curl)
